pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. blue

2. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.

3. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

4. When practising Pre- Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre- Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre- Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre- Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre- Writing.

5. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. went
   C. going
   D. goes

6. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.

7. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a describing word

8. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.

9. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.

10. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.

11. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.

12. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library?

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pronunciation and Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
